companies.title: Companies
companies.description: One per line. Paste a careers-page URL (boards.greenhouse.io/stripe, jobs.lever.co/palantir, jobs.ashbyhq.com/ramp, jobs.smartrecruiters.com/BoschGroup, bunq.recruitee.com), write platform:name (ashby:ramp), or just the company name as it appears in its careers URL (notion) and the platform is detected for you.

titleKeywords.title: Job title must contain (any of)
titleKeywords.description: Keep only jobs whose title contains at least one of these words. Leave empty for all jobs.

excludeTitleKeywords.title: Job title must not contain
excludeTitleKeywords.description: Drop jobs whose title contains any of these words (for example: intern, senior).

locationKeywords.title: Location must contain (any of)
locationKeywords.description: Keep only jobs whose location contains one of these (for example: London, Germany, Remote).

remoteOnly.title: Remote jobs only
remoteOnly.description: Keep only jobs marked remote by the employer.

postedWithinDays.title: Posted within the last N days
postedWithinDays.description: Keep only jobs published in the last N days. Leave empty for no date filter.

onlyNewJobs.title: Only jobs not returned by earlier runs
onlyNewJobs.description: Turn this on and schedule the Actor to get a feed of newly posted jobs. Each job is returned once per monitor.

monitorName.title: Monitor name
monitorName.description: Used with the option above. Runs sharing a monitor name share their memory of returned jobs; use different names for separate feeds.

includeDescription.title: Include full job description
includeDescription.description: Turn off for smaller, faster output.

maxJobsPerCompany.title: Max jobs per company
maxJobsPerCompany.description: Cap the number of jobs returned for each company. Leave empty for no cap.
